verdict.rationale: Cal.com is a scheduling platform, so AI task time-blocking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only covers booking pages, slot availability, a manual reschedule API, and an MCP server or agent API that external AI clients can use to manage bookings. Those are developer building blocks and adjacent booking features. Nothing shows Cal.com itself placing a user's tasks into calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, or re-planning them automatically when things change.
